## Crossfade

**Smooth crossfades in the Music app.** One song fades out while the next fades in. Set how long in Settings → Crossfade.

- Works with songs stored on your iPhone, so no subscription is needed.

- **iOS 15 and 16.** Rootless and RootHide jailbreaks.
- Tested on an iPhone 8 Plus (iOS 16.7).
- If it ever sends your phone to Safe Mode, open Sileo (it still works there) and uninstall it. Then [tell me](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues).
- Apple Music streaming songs are protected, so they don't crossfade.
